records.title: Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS)
records.summary: Swelling of the optic disc, flattening of the back of the eye and folds in the retina, likely from headward fluid shift.

data.signs: Near-vision blur; may persist after flight.
data.countermeasures: Onboard eye imaging, adjustable glasses, research on thigh cuffs and lower body negative pressure.

records.title: Bone loss
records.summary: Weight-bearing bones can lose roughly 1-1.5% of mineral density per month without countermeasures.

data.countermeasures: Heavy resistive exercise (ARED), adequate calories, vitamin D, bisphosphonates in studies.

records.title: Muscle atrophy
records.summary: Postural muscles such as calves and back lose mass and strength without load.

data.countermeasures: Daily resistive and aerobic exercise; adequate protein.

records.title: Kidney stones
records.summary: Calcium from bone, lower fluid intake and urine changes raise stone risk.

data.signs: Severe flank pain, blood in urine.
data.countermeasures: Drink 2+ L/day, potassium citrate in studies, limit salt and animal protein.

records.title: Cardiovascular deconditioning
records.summary: The heart works against less gravity and blood volume drops 10-15%.

data.signs: Lower exercise capacity; dizziness on return.
data.countermeasures: Aerobic exercise; fluid loading before landing; compression garments.

records.title: Orthostatic intolerance
records.summary: Blood pools in the legs on standing after adaptation to weightlessness.

data.countermeasures: Fluid loading, compression garments, gradual standing.

records.title: Headward fluid shift
records.summary: About 2 L of fluid moves from the legs toward the head.

data.countermeasures: Expected adaptation; relevant to SANS research.

records.title: Space motion sickness
records.summary: The inner ear and eyes send conflicting signals.

data.countermeasures: Medication, limited head movement, gradual adaptation.

records.title: Sleep loss and circadian disruption
records.summary: 16 sunrises a day in LEO, noise, workload and CO₂ all disturb sleep.

data.signs: Fatigue, slower reaction time, mood changes.
data.countermeasures: Circadian lighting, sleep hygiene, scheduling, melatonin, sleep medication.

records.title: Behavioural health decline
records.summary: Isolation, confinement and monotony can lower mood and team cohesion.

data.countermeasures: Private family calls, ground psychological support, crew selection and training, meaningful work.

records.title: Immune dysregulation
records.summary: Immune cells change behaviour; latent viruses (EBV, VZV, CMV) reactivate more often.

data.signs: Rashes, cold sores, shingles, slower healing.
data.countermeasures: Stress management, sleep, nutrition, prompt treatment.

records.title: Acute radiation sickness
records.summary: Only from a very large solar particle event without shelter.

data.signs: Nausea, vomiting, fatigue, later blood-cell drop.
data.countermeasures: Storm shelter, dosimetry, space-weather forecasting.

records.title: Long-term cancer risk
records.summary: Cumulative dose from cosmic rays raises lifetime cancer risk.

data.countermeasures: Dose tracking against the career limit; shielding; shorter transit times.

records.title: Central nervous system effects
records.summary: Animal studies suggest heavy ions may affect memory and behaviour.

data.countermeasures: Shielding; research ongoing.

records.title: Spinal elongation and disc risk
records.summary: The spine lengthens by up to several centimetres.

data.signs: Back pain early in flight; higher disc herniation risk after return.
data.countermeasures: Stretching, exercise, careful reconditioning.

records.title: Skin problems
records.summary: Dry air, limited washing and immune changes.

data.countermeasures: Moisturiser, hygiene, topical treatments.

records.title: Dental problems
records.summary: Limited dental care available.

data.countermeasures: Strict pre-flight dental care; onboard dental kit.

records.title: Noise-induced hearing effects
records.summary: Constant fan and pump noise.

data.countermeasures: Hearing protection, noise limits.

records.title: Under-eating and weight loss
records.summary: Appetite drops, food is monotonous and workload is high.

data.countermeasures: Varied menu, tracking intake, calorie-dense foods.

records.title: Space anaemia
records.summary: A 2022 study (Trudel et al.) found the body destroys 54% more red blood cells in space than on Earth.

data.countermeasures: Nutrition; monitoring on return.

records.title: Insulin resistance
records.summary: Inactivity and spaceflight changes can reduce insulin sensitivity.

data.countermeasures: Exercise, diet.

records.title: Lunar dust toxicity
records.summary: Sharp, abrasive, electrostatically clingy dust.

data.countermeasures: Dust control at the airlock, suitports, air filtration.
